newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Hang Lung actively buying land - paper.
newsitem.headline: Hang Lung actively buying land - paper.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Lung Development Co Ltd plans to acquire more than 2.0 million square feet of land in the coming year, the Apple Daily newspaper said on Wednesday.
The acquisitions would be financed through internal channels and would not call for any fundraising, the newspaper quoted chairman Ronnie Chan as saying.
The newspaper did not say how much money would be involved.

Chan said the company would be actively buying land to replenish its land bank, which now stood at about 2.5 million to 3.0 million square feet, down from the 5.0 million square feet it used to maintain.
He was also quoted as saying the developer planned to bid for the third phase of the Tung Chung development on Lantau island, a new town which is part of the Chek Lap Kok airport project.
Chan was not immediately available to comment.
